questions.question: What does David ask God to do in Psalm 26?
options: Forgive and cleanse him, for he has sinned
Strengthen and arm him, for the great battle draws near
Enrich and honor him, for he has served well
Vindicate and examine him, for he walks in integrity
questions.answer: Vindicate and examine him, for he walks in integrity

questions.question: What does David say he loves?
options: The gates of the city, where justice is done
The courts of the great king, where the mighty all gather
The fields of his fathers, where he was born
The habitation of God's house, where his glory dwells
questions.answer: The habitation of God's house, where his glory dwells
